body: Forward test of the flags-judgment context method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.20 (naive base rate 0.30) that: Indo Tech Transformers' promoter pledge (as % of total shares) is lower in the Mar-2027 disclosure than the 57.93% reported for Sep-2026. Evidence: NSE pledge data (broadcast 20-Nov-2026, SHP 30-Sep-2026): promoter holding 70.29% of 1.062 cr shares; 82.41% of promoter shares encumbered = 57.93% of total. Pledges/encumbrances in favour of trustees (Catalyst Trusteeship, SBICAP Trustee) on behalf of the promoter Shirdi Sai Electricals (SSEL)'s lenders since Oct–Nov 2025; SSEL sold shares on the open market on 29–30 Jun 2026. memdb event:INDOTECH:avoid-2026-11-19 flags this as a red flag. Reasoning: The encumbrance secures the promoter group's own borrowings (not a margin loan), which tends to persist until the group refinances; open-market sales by the promoter suggest liquidity need, not release. Flags-judgment: this flag has a verifiable mechanism (lender security), so we expect it to stay. Resolution: YES if the NSE pledge/encumbrance disclosure for the 31-Mar-2027 shareholding pattern shows promoter shares pledged/encumbered as % of total shares < 57.93% (a fall caused only by the promoter selling pledged shares still counts as YES; any increase or no change = NO). data.base_rate_reasoning: India non-financial, mcap Rs 1,000-20,000 cr at T, 5 yrs from 30-Sep-2016 and 30-Sep-2018 (survivorship-free, dead firms included, stratum-weighted). n=208 company-snapshots (54 distress-census D, 153 live L at weight 5.63, 1 delisted-other X at 4.26); 95% CIs (company bootstrap within stratum): P(>=3x) 14.1-28.7%, P(<=0.5x) 7.0-16.1%, P(blow-up) 10.2-21.4%. Two start dates only, and they disagree (2016: >=3x 16%, blow-up 21%; 2018: 26%, 10%). Price return only (no dividends, ~1%/yr). Blow-up = close <=0.2x the close at T, liquidation or compulsory delisting (no fraud field). Remaining survivorship leak toward FEWER failures (IBBI firms renamed/merged and 221 IBBI rows without identifiers missing; voluntary/merger delistings X under-covered). A survivors-only sample from the same frame says P(<=0.5x) 7% instead of 11%.
